boundaries.name: Operator to local process
boundaries.description: CLI, dashboard and local-runner requests cross into Metriplane processes.

boundaries.name: Process to filesystem
boundaries.description: Configuration, recordings, archives, state and evidence cross the filesystem boundary.

boundaries.name: Listener to network client
boundaries.description: HTTP, metrics and WebSocket listeners accept network-originated input.

boundaries.name: Parent to child process
boundaries.description: Allowlisted commands execute below the runner process.

boundaries.name: External source to adapter
boundaries.description: Third-party robotics datasets and recordings enter adapter normalization.

boundaries.name: Repository to CI and release
boundaries.description: Repository bytes become tested, attested and promoted artifacts.

assets.name: Source recordings
assets.description: Operator and adapter input data whose bytes and identity must remain attributable.

assets.name: Evidence bundles
assets.description: Deterministic reports, manifests and provenance used for audit and comparison.

assets.name: Runtime state
assets.description: Mutable process state, journals and current-generation pointers.

assets.name: Credentials and capabilities
assets.description: Bearer tokens and per-session mutation capabilities.

assets.name: Host resources
assets.description: CPU, memory, storage, descriptors and process slots.

assets.name: Published packages
assets.description: Exact wheel, sdist and release artifact bytes.

assets.name: Security and audit records
assets.description: Control registry, test evidence, attestations and retained incidents.

actors.name: Local unprivileged process
actors.description: Another process sharing the host or user session.

actors.name: Remote network client
actors.description: A client able to reach an explicitly exposed listener.

actors.name: Untrusted data producer
actors.description: Producer of archives, recordings or adapter inputs.

actors.name: Child command
actors.description: Allowlisted executable running with constrained inherited authority.

actors.name: CI or provider identity
actors.description: Hosted automation producing checks, attestations and artifacts.

abuse_cases.title: Unauthorized local mutation
abuse_cases.scenario: A same-host process attempts to reuse or discover a mutation capability.

abuse_cases.title: Unauthenticated remote exposure
abuse_cases.scenario: A listener is bound beyond numeric loopback without an explicit authentication policy.

abuse_cases.title: Archive traversal or expansion denial
abuse_cases.scenario: A crafted archive escapes its destination or exceeds bounded extraction resources.

abuse_cases.title: Symlink substitution
abuse_cases.scenario: A path is replaced between validation, copying, hashing or publication.

abuse_cases.title: Child process resource or identity abuse
abuse_cases.scenario: A command floods output, leaks descendants or causes a reused PID to receive a signal.

abuse_cases.title: Sensitive evidence disclosure
abuse_cases.scenario: Public export includes secrets, host paths or protected identity fields.

abuse_cases.title: Untrusted adapter input
abuse_cases.scenario: An undeclared source, oversized dataset or non-canonical value enters normalization.

abuse_cases.title: Artifact or provenance substitution
abuse_cases.scenario: A check or attestation for different source, workflow or bytes is reused for promotion.

controls.title: Per-session mutation capability
controls.mechanism: Mutation routes require an unlogged, non-GET per-session capability.

controls.title: No credential disclosure
controls.mechanism: Tokens are excluded from served assets, URLs, GET responses and logs.

controls.title: Loopback or explicit remote authentication
controls.mechanism: Listeners default to numeric loopback and non-loopback binding requires authentication.

controls.title: No-follow filesystem traversal
controls.mechanism: Archive and directory ingestion reject traversal, links and substitution during staged copy and hash.

controls.title: Calibrated resource budgets
controls.mechanism: Shared lexical and resource limits reject N+1 inputs while accepting calibrated N-1 and N cases.

controls.title: Atomic exact-byte publication
controls.mechanism: Immutable generations, journals and last-written manifests bind the published byte set.

controls.title: Bounded child execution
controls.mechanism: Minimal environment, output caps, limits and birth/executable/argv identity protect process cleanup.

controls.title: Deterministic redacted public export
controls.mechanism: A minimal allowlist and protected diagnostics sidecar keep secrets and identities out of public evidence.

controls.title: Offline allowlisted acquisition
controls.mechanism: Acquisition admits only declared sources and normalization runs unprivileged, credential-empty and quota-bound.

controls.title: OIDC identity and digest verification
controls.mechanism: Promotion verifies subject, issuer, workflow, ref/event, commit and artifact digest and fails closed.
